# Study 5 — GDX standalone D1, and B5 restricted to VGT/KRE/GDX (2026-10-30)

Two linked studies under one frozen protocol: **(A)** standalone GDX D1 phenotypes (fixed $100,000, net of 11% margin
interest and 5 bps per side, minute-sampled maximum drawdown strictly below $35,000); **(B)** the frozen B5 shared pool
with its eligible universe restricted to **VGT, KRE and GDX** — the exclusion effect without retuning, the original B5
optimization method re-run faithfully, and supplemental staged/joint and robust-plateau optimization. No D1 rule,
allocator rule, fill, cost, interest or margin convention was changed; only the eight registered D1 parameters varied.

## Answer in brief

- **Data:** canonical files through **2026-10-29** (12 sessions appended by the user on 2026-10-30; every earlier byte
  equals the frozen B5 pins). DEV 2017-06-15 → 2021-12-31 for search, VAL 2022–2023 for selection (within-study only:
  2016–2023 trained every earlier study), FX 2024-01-02 → 2026-10-13 **previously exposed** (opened once after the
  freeze), RECENT 2026-10-14 → 2026-10-29 (never seen; one GDX lot, open).
- **Excluding XBI/XRT without retuning** costs $67,532 over the full history ($484,637 → $417,105; minute DD
  unchanged at $26,510), but only $1,567 in 2024–2026 and nothing in the new sessions.
- **XRT lot #88** (2025-11-12 → 2026-03-03, −$759.64) blocked **no GDX trade**: GDX had no signal in that interval,
  XRT never refused GDX at any time, and without XRT the slot went to a VGT trade that lost $2,325.67.
- **Study A: no nominee.** Every shortlisted GDX vector fails the neighbourhood drawdown gate (2022 bear). Three
  near-identical vectors fail only that gate; they are published as labelled research phenotypes, not recommended.
- **Study B: no nominee.** The faithful B5 method (reproduced bit-for-bit on its original data) and the supplemental
  methods produced no restricted configuration that passes the joint-neighbourhood risk gate; none beat the frozen
  ablation in the exposed window; one breached $35,000 there; staged/joint optimization overfit.
- **Recommendation:** keep frozen B5 as the reference; if GDX is pursued, observe forward (paper), do not search
  further on 2016–2026. See [RECOMMENDATION.md](RECOMMENDATION.md).
